notes.title: tntodion update release date
notes.content: hello! We forgot to say that in November 2022 we suspended the development of TNTODION. We will continue it this summer with new thoughts and release a really good game. We update the character models, locations, and so on. also, many players complained about the optimization. we ask you to be patient and thank you for staying with us.

notes.title: The second chapter is out!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello![/h1]

Surely you have been waiting for [b] the second chapter [/b] of our game! We tried our best to release the game much faster so that you can play it soon. [b]I hope[/b] we won't disappoint you!

ːsteamthumbsupː Yours, [b]FEDYA CLAPTON inc.[/b]

notes.title: When is the second chapter?
notes.content:
Hello, dear subscribers of [b]TNTODION[/b]! Surely you are wondering: Why is the development of the game so long? 
The answer is simple: we updated the locations. We try to exceed your expectations because we want to make the game process [b]exciting[/b] and [b]attractive[/b] with a graphical component. We experimented and selected the best option, it remains only to embed it in the desired locations.
Soon, we will continue to work on the second chapter of the game again and we will notify you of all innovations and news.
Yours, [b]FEDYA CLAPTON inc.[/b]

notes.title: Appeal to our subscribers.
notes.content:
Hello! We see what you write to us and it's nice. We are putting all our efforts into a fist so that the game is not only interesting, but also long, so that you can enjoy the game to the fullest. Unfortunately, development does take a lot of time, so we ask you for a little patience. As soon as we are ready to release a global update for you, we will notify you!

With best wishes,

FEDYA CLAPTON inc.

notes.title: Update 2.5b1
notes.content:
- Added notifications about new characters.
- Added a TV to the menu. By clicking on it, you can find out about all the open characters, as well as find out their description.
- Added new buttons in the settings, R.L.O - removes objects loading the system.
- Added buttons to turn off sounds or music
- Fixed bugs

notes.title: Development of the second part
notes.content:
Hello! There hasn't been any news on the game for a long time, so I decided to tell you what I'm working on in the second part of the game.
Firstly, I have modeled a couple of new characters for the game, but some scenes will use old models as well.
Secondly, I have developed several locations. Basically, this delay is due to cut scenes.
Thirdly, a new ability will be added to the player (but you will learn about it already in the game itself).
I hope to develop the second part as soon as possible, but if bugs are noticed, the release will have to be delayed. Updates of the first part will be released gradually, if there is something to add.
Wait for news, but most likely they will not be so often.

notes.title: Update 1.1.3b4
notes.content:
1. Added a zone where you can stop. If the player accidentally flies away or falls to the ground, then he will be returned back.
2. Bugs fixed

notes.title: Beta-version
notes.content:
Hello! I would like to talk about what has changed over the month of March. Not many, but they know that I am the only one developing the game, so the release of the game may be delayed. And it's not a fact that it won't be until June. During this time, I added a couple of new locations, mastered programming and modeling better. My game should be released this month (if there are no problems with steamworks. This will be a beta version of the game, which is a partially full version). I hope I won't disappoint. See you soon!
FEDYA CLAPTON inc.

notes.title: First post
notes.content: At the moment, the game is still in development, but don't worry! I'm trying to finalize the game by the approximate release date of the game. Understand that if the release date has changed, then you need more time to develop. I try to extend the plot as much as possible if I have ideas. This is my first announcement. Don't forget to join my VK group vk.com/tntodion to know the news about the game.
